caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a large, trapezoidal bell or a wooden container with a handle on top. The main body of the object is made of dark brown wood with a vertical grain pattern. Each of the four vertical edges is reinforced with a broad, reddish-brown strip or band that is secured with regularly spaced metal studs or rivets. There are two ornate metal handles, one on each visible side, attached near the center, both colored in a dull gray-blue tone and shaped with decorative curves. The top of the object is flat and features a solid, thick, rounded handle made of light brown wood, attached perpendicular to the body. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and free of any additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature "VI. KLECKKNOZEL" appears near the bottom right of the image.
title: Rattle (Matraca)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
